test_suite_name: V3 Orion Arrival and Targeting Acceptance
description: In the same serving V3 process, ordinary-player warp/transwarp arrivals are tested against the real Orion blockader scheduler. Confirms faction initialization retries after the world initially lacked Orion records.

tests.name: Bootstrap disposable SysOp session
Reconnect hostile ordinary player after restart
Reconnect allied ordinary player after restart
Login safe-zone arrival player after restart
Read Orion controlled-sector center after restart

data.sql: SELECT center_sector FROM clusters WHERE role='ORION' LIMIT 1;

tests.name: Read non-FedSpace route origin after restart

data.sql: SELECT MIN(sector_id) FROM sectors WHERE sector_id>10 AND sector_id<>@{orion_arrival_home};

tests.name: Disable NPC task while preparing player arrivals

data.sql: UPDATE cron_tasks SET enabled=FALSE WHERE name='npc_step';

tests.name: Defer unrelated cron jobs for the focused real scheduler tick

data.sql: UPDATE cron_tasks SET next_due_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP+INTERVAL '1 day' WHERE name<>'npc_step' AND enabled=TRUE;

tests.name: Put both ordinary players at the common route origin

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id=@{orion_arrival_origin} WHERE name IN ('orion_arrival_hostile','orion_arrival_allied');

tests.name: Prepare ships for normal warp and one-hop transwarp

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=@{orion_arrival_origin},has_transwarp=TRUE,shields=0,hull=100,fighters=100,ore=3,onplanet=FALSE,destroyed=FALSE WHERE ship_id IN (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name IN ('orion_arrival_hostile','orion_arrival_allied'));

tests.name: Synchronize Fuel Ore for transwarp

data.sql: INSERT INTO ship_cargo(ship_id,commodity_code,quantity) SELECT ship_id,'ORE',3 FROM players WHERE name IN ('orion_arrival_hostile','orion_arrival_allied') ON CONFLICT(ship_id,commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity=3;

tests.name: Stage the five QA Orion NPC ships as a blockader and patrols

data.sql: WITH reset_fleet AS (UPDATE ships s SET sector_id=@{orion_arrival_home},personality='defensive',shields=0,hull=100,destroyed=FALSE FROM ship_ownership so JOIN players p ON p.player_id=so.player_id JOIN corp_members cm ON cm.player_id=p.player_id JOIN corporations c ON c.corporation_id=cm.corporation_id WHERE so.ship_id=s.ship_id AND p.is_npc=TRUE AND c.tag='ORION' AND COALESCE(s.destroyed,FALSE)=FALSE AND s.name NOT LIKE 'Orion QA NPC hull %'), qa AS (UPDATE ships SET sector_id=@{orion_arrival_home},personality=CASE WHEN name='Orion QA NPC hull 1' THEN 'blockader' ELSE 'defensive' END WHERE name LIKE 'Orion QA NPC hull %' RETURNING ship_id) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qa;

tests.name: Refresh authoritative contexts after restart
Refresh allied player's authoritative context
Allied normal warp and hostile transwarp arrive concurrently
Both travel mechanisms reach Orion-controlled sector

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM players WHERE name IN ('orion_arrival_hostile','orion_arrival_allied') AND sector_id=@{orion_arrival_home})=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

tests.name: Record hostile hull before NPC combat

data.sql: SELECT hull FROM ships WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='orion_arrival_hostile');

tests.name: Clear only this fixture fleet action receipts before its first controlled scheduler tick

data.sql: DELETE FROM npc_action_log WHERE faction='ORION' AND npc_ship_id IN (SELECT s.ship_id FROM ships s JOIN ship_ownership so ON so.ship_id=s.ship_id JOIN players p ON p.player_id=so.player_id WHERE p.name LIKE 'Orion QA captain %');

tests.name: Ordinary player cannot invoke the SysOp NPC test hook
Run the authoritative NPC scheduler handler through the SysOp acceptance hook
Hostile arrival takes one NPC combat hit while Orion ally is untouched

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT hull FROM ships WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='orion_arrival_hostile'))<@{orion_hull_before} AND (SELECT hull FROM ships WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='orion_arrival_allied'))=100 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM npc_action_log WHERE faction='ORION' AND action_type='blockade_attack' AND target_player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='orion_arrival_hostile') AND sector_id=@{orion_arrival_home} AND status='completed')=1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM npc_action_log WHERE faction='ORION' AND action_type='blockade_attack' AND target_player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='orion_arrival_allied')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

tests.name: Orion scheduler does not claim or move a human corporation member ship as an NPC

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM npc_action_log l JOIN ship_ownership so ON so.ship_id=l.npc_ship_id JOIN players p ON p.player_id=so.player_id JOIN corp_members cm ON cm.player_id=p.player_id JOIN corporations c ON c.corporation_id=cm.corporation_id WHERE c.tag='ORION' AND p.is_npc=FALSE;

tests.name: Capture hull after first NPC action

data.sql: SELECT hull FROM ships WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='orion_arrival_hostile');

tests.name: Retry the authoritative NPC handler within the same idempotency window
Same-window scheduler retry does not repeat combat damage

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT hull FROM ships WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='orion_arrival_hostile'))=@{orion_hull_after} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM npc_action_log WHERE faction='ORION' AND action_type='blockade_attack' AND target_player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='orion_arrival_hostile') AND sector_id=@{orion_arrival_home} AND status='completed');

tests.name: Stage an Orion blockader and ordinary player in overlapping FedSpace sector 10

data.sql: WITH player_reset AS (UPDATE players SET sector_id=1 WHERE name='orion_safe_zone_arrival' RETURNING player_id,ship_id), safe_ship AS (UPDATE ships s SET sector_id=1,onplanet=FALSE,destroyed=FALSE,hull=100,shields=0,fighters=0 FROM player_reset p WHERE s.ship_id=p.ship_id RETURNING s.ship_id), npc_blockader AS (UPDATE ships s SET sector_id=10,personality='blockader',destroyed=FALSE,hull=100,shields=0 FROM ship_ownership so JOIN players p ON p.player_id=so.player_id WHERE so.ship_id=s.ship_id AND p.name='Orion QA captain 1' RETURNING s.ship_id) DELETE FROM npc_action_log l USING player_reset p WHERE l.faction='ORION' AND l.target_player_id=p.player_id;

tests.name: Clear disposable deployed defenses from the FedSpace travel path

data.sql: DELETE FROM sector_assets WHERE sector_id IN (2,10);

tests.name: Safe-zone player enters the Orion-overlap sector by ordinary warp
Safe-zone player continues ordinary warp into sector 10
Confirm Orion-controlled safe-zone arrival before scheduler settlement

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT sector_id=10 FROM players WHERE name='orion_safe_zone_arrival')::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)>0 FROM cluster_sectors cs JOIN clusters c ON c.clusters_id=cs.cluster_id WHERE c.role='ORION' AND cs.sector_id=10)::int,(SELECT hull=100 FROM ships WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='orion_safe_zone_arrival'))::int;

tests.name: Run authoritative Orion scheduler with a blockader in protected FedSpace
FedSpace protection prevents Orion attack and preserves hull

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT hull=100 FROM ships WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='orion_safe_zone_arrival'))::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=0 FROM npc_action_log WHERE faction='ORION' AND action_type IN ('attack','blockade_attack') AND target_player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='orion_safe_zone_arrival'))::int;

tests.name: Stage a hostile target after its Orion blockader is removed before settlement

data.sql: WITH target AS (UPDATE players SET sector_id=@{orion_arrival_home} WHERE name='orion_arrival_hostile' RETURNING player_id,ship_id), target_ship AS (UPDATE ships s SET sector_id=@{orion_arrival_home},onplanet=FALSE,destroyed=FALSE,hull=100,shields=0 FROM target t WHERE s.ship_id=t.ship_id RETURNING s.ship_id), quiet_fleet AS (UPDATE ships s SET sector_id=@{orion_arrival_home},personality='defensive',destroyed=(p.name='Orion QA captain 1') FROM ship_ownership so JOIN players p ON p.player_id=so.player_id JOIN corp_members cm ON cm.player_id=p.player_id JOIN corporations c ON c.corporation_id=cm.corporation_id WHERE so.ship_id=s.ship_id AND c.tag='ORION' AND p.is_npc=TRUE RETURNING s.ship_id) DELETE FROM npc_action_log WHERE faction='ORION' AND action_type='blockade_attack' AND target_player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM target);

tests.name: Verify the targeting blockader is destroyed before scheduler settlement

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(destroyed,FALSE) FROM ships WHERE name='Orion QA NPC hull 1')::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=0 FROM npc_action_log WHERE faction='ORION' AND action_type='blockade_attack' AND target_player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='orion_arrival_hostile'))::int,(SELECT hull=100 FROM ships WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='orion_arrival_hostile'))::int;

tests.name: Settle scheduler after blockader removal
Removed blockader cannot attack during scheduler settlement

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT hull=100 FROM ships WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='orion_arrival_hostile'))::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=0 FROM npc_action_log WHERE faction='ORION' AND action_type='blockade_attack' AND target_player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='orion_arrival_hostile'))::int;

Logout Orion-allied player
Logout safe-zone player
